_meta.description: Recommended absolute paths on the Debian/apt builder image to COPY into a minimal or distroless runtime stage. Used by lib_search_and_inject.py (merged with built-in defaults; entries here override same package keys).
rationale: Docker multi-stage builds: install tools and libs in a full base image, then COPY --from=builder only what the runtime needs.
Distroless and minimal bases omit apt/dpkg; anything not copied is missing at runtime.
Prefer apt-get install --no-install-recommends in Dockerfiles to limit transitive packages (Docker build best practices).
Where a binary needs many .so files, validate with ldd on the builder and extend this map (pattern described in Docker ecosystem guidance).
